Director, Technical Operations Strategy, Execution \& Transformation
  
  

Alfasigma is a privately held global healthcare company founded over 75 years ago in Italy, where it remains headquartered today in Bologna and Milan. The Group operates in over 100 markets spanning Europe, North and South America, Asia, and Africa.
  
  

Over three years ago, we embarked on a transformative journey to become a truly global innovative healthcare company with a leading focus on Gastrointestinal (GI) health. We have experienced remarkable growth, nearly doubled our revenues, expanding geographically, and integrating several key acquisitions. We have also evolved our portfolio, expanded into rare and specialty segments, and strengthened our pipeline and people's capabilities.
  
  

But our journey is far from complete! In fact, this is just the beginning of a bold new chapter in Alfasigma's history. We are committed to advancing innovation and leveraging our deep expertise to provide better health and a better quality of life for patients and consumers worldwide and expand our reach across diverse markets.
  
  

Scope of the role
  
  

The Technical Operations (TechOps) Strategy, Execution \& Transformation Director is responsible for leading the governance and execution of the Technical Operations strategic portfolio, ensuring alignment between corporate strategy and operational delivery across a complex global manufacturing network.
  
  

Reporting directly to the Chief Technical Operations Officer, the role oversees a portfolio of transformation, operational excellence, network optimization, capacity expansion, product launch, and integration initiatives across internal manufacturing sites and external partners (CDMOs). The incumbent drives portfolio governance, resource prioritization, investment planning, and cross\-functional coordination to ensure the successful delivery of strategic objectives while maximizing business value.
  
  

As a key advisor to the CTOO and Executive Leadership Team, the Director provides visibility into portfolio performance, risks, dependencies, and investment decisions, while leading a team of Project Managers and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. The role may also directly manage selected critical strategic projects when required.
  
  

Success in this position requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, financial acumen, and a deep understanding of pharmaceutical operations, combined with expertise in Lean principles and transformation methodologies.
  
  

Your Role
  
Program \& Portfolio Management
  
Manage strategic or highly complex projects directly when required.
  
Partner with business leaders to support organizational readiness, stakeholder engagement, and adoption of strategic initiatives.
  
Ensure project deliverables meet business objectives, compliance requirements, and operational expectations.
  
Drive measurable business outcomes through the successful delivery of strategic initiatives.
  
Identify, evaluate, and prioritize projects within the portfolio in alignment with corporate strategy and stakeholder expectations.
  
Continuously assess and optimize the portfolio to reflect changing business priorities, risks, opportunities, and operational needs.
  
Define program roadmaps, governance structures, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms.
  
Ensure effective allocation and optimization of resources and investment expenditures.
  
Coordinate execution across multiple manufacturing and technical sites.
  
Identify, monitor, and proactively manage dependencies across programs, sites, and functions to minimize delivery risks.
  
Maintain an integrated portfolio view, highlighting interdependencies, cumulative impacts, resource constraints, and opportunities for synergy.
  
Facilitate trade\-off decisions when priorities, timelines, or resource requirements compete.
  
Project Governance \& Execution
  
Maintain, enhance, and standardize project and program management practices across the organization.
  
Ensure all projects are supported by robust feasibility assessments and business cases before approval.
  
Implement governance frameworks that enable timely and informed decision\-making while maintaining quality, compliance, and oversight.
  
Monitor and report business benefits throughout the program lifecycle to ensure strategic investments achieve intended outcomes.
  
Provide regular updates to executive leadership on project progress, financial performance, risks, and mitigation plans.
  
Ensure project management tools, methodologies, and systems are effectively deployed and continuously improved.
  
Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to governance, project execution, and portfolio management processes.
  
Partner with Finance to assess investment requirements, monitor portfolio expenditures, and provide financial analyses to support prioritization and strategic decisions.
  
Who You Are
  
Education
  
Master's degree in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  
Project Management and/or Program Management certification is preferred.
  
Experience
  
Minimum of 10 years of experience in Program and Project Management.
  
Proven track record of leading complex, international, and cross\-functional portfolios.
  
Demonstrated experience managing interdependencies, competing priorities, and resource conflicts across organizational boundaries.
  
Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
  
Proven leadership experience managing Project Managers and multidisciplinary teams.
  
Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, manufacturing, or similarly regulated industries is highly desirable.
  
Technical \& Professional Skills
  
Strong knowledge of Program and Portfolio Management methodologies.
  
Advanced financial acumen, including portfolio budgeting, investment evaluation, forecasting, cost management, and financial impact assessment.
  
Demonstrated ability to identify, integrate, and manage dependencies across programs, functions, sites, and external partners.
  
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving capabilities.
  
Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
  
Ability to leverage digital portfolio management tools, data analytics, and emerging technologies to enhance reporting, visibility, and decision\-making.
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced and international environment.
  
Solid understanding of Lean Management principles and continuous improvement methodologies.
  
Leadership Competencies
  
Strategic thinking and business alignment.
  
Cross\-functional collaboration and partnership building.
  
Influencing and stakeholder engagement.
  
Consensus building and negotiation across competing priorities.
  
Team leadership and talent development.
  
Decision\-making and accountability.
  
Continuous improvement mindset.
  
Results orientation.
  
Change management and organizational agility.
  
Key Relationships
  
  

Build effective delivery partnerships across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Facilities \& EHS, CDMOs, and other relevant functions to align dependencies, resolve competing priorities, and drive successful end\-to\-end program delivery.
  
  

Pay range 95\.000€ \- 120\.000€
  
  

The compensation range indicated in this job posting represents an estimated average range for the position. The final remuneration will be determined based on the selected candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, in accordance with applicable EU pay transparency and pay equity requirements
  
  

**Why Join Alfasigma:**  

At Alfasigma, we foster a culture where the courage to innovate is key to our success.
  
We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and extensive opportunities for professional growth and development.
  
  

Our commitment to people and patients is at the heart of everything we do. We value diversity and welcome individuals with unique perspectives and experiences. We believe that open\-mindedness, collaboration, and a shared passion for innovation are essential to achieving meaningful progress.
  
  

Join Alfasigma and become part of a forward\-thinking team dedicated to shaping the future of the pharmaceutical industry.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Milan, Italy \| Full time \| Home\-based \| R1566832  
The IQVIA sponsor\-dedicated Clinical Functional Service Partnerships (Clinical FSP) department is supporting our client’s project team in the execution of clinical trials. Joining the team provides the opportunity to manage clinical research projects in different therapeutic areas and to cooperate closely with one of our key clients.  


We currently offer the exciting opportunity to join the team as Clinical Study Manager in full\-time and work home\-based in Italy. In this role you will be accountable for the operational and scientific oversight, the set\-up, execution and delivery of your assigned clinical trials at the local level.  


MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES  


Plans and leads execution of day\-to\-day activities for the monitoring of a complex clinical study and communicates consistently with the clinical team providing project objectives, expectations, and status updates.  


Has the overall responsibility for the study commitments within the country and for timely delivery of data to required quality.  


Provides Project Oversight \& Leadership for Clinical Deliverables  


Leads and manages the clinical teams  


Leads and supports the relevant staff (ie. local start\-up staff, local and global regulatory affairs staff, inhouse clinical staff, etc) to drive successful activation of trial sites  


Monitors the quality of clinical activities and addresses quality issues with the appropriate team member  


Reviews and approves site visit reports within agreed turnaround times and ensures tracking, follow up, and resolution of site issues  


Works with the relevant staff to identify data related issues and risks to clinical activities; develops contingency and mitigation plans to minimize risks  


Creates and maintains project\-specific plans, documents, and tools for the clinical team  


Supports the CRAs with site monitoring activities and provides suggestions and solutions to site issues  


Oversees the relevant regulatory and in\-house clinical staff to ensure that all non\-safety periodic updates, progress reports, and renewals, and/or end of study notifications are performed in accordance with the trial protocol, local regulations, ICH GCP, and any other processes or procedures governing the clinical trial  


Acts as coordinating manager to ensure consistency of training, processes, and systems\-related activities as well as ad\-hoc coordinating activities  


REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS  


Bachelor degree in related discipline, preferably in life science  


Five or more years of experience in clinical research, including a minimum of 4 years project management experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the key responsibilities of the job  


Good knowledge of international guidelines ICH GCP as well as relevant local regulations  


Proven ability to lead and motivate cross functional teams to deliver clinical trials according to or ahead of time plan, budget and with required quality  


Previous work experience in TA's: Oncology or Onco\-hematology is required  


Good knowledge of the Drug Development Process  


Excellent knowledge of spoken and written English and Italian language.  


Good ability to learn and to adapt to work with IT systems.  


Effective decision\-making is crucial for resolving challenges and ensuring alignment with overall study goals.  


Experience in monitoring study activities for compliance and inspection readiness.  


Strong interpersonal skills are vital for collaborating with internal teams, stakeholders, and external vendors.  


A deep understanding of clinical operations processes, including trial data collection and management, is paramount to ensuring successful study execution.  


Location in Milan and Rome is preferred.  


Please note: due to sponsor requirements for the role only candidates based in the listed location/s will be considered. Any applications from candidates based outside of these locations will not be considered.  


IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com  


IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.  


The potential base pay range for this role, when annualized, is 53 200,00 € \- 79 800,00 €. The actual base pay offered may vary based on a number of factors including job\-related qualifications such as knowledge, skills, education, and experience; location; and/or schedule (full or part\-time). Dependent on the position offered, incentive plans, bonuses, and/or other forms of compensation may be offered, in addition to a range of health and welfare and/or other benefits.  
Where you'll work  
Home\-based  


You’ll work remotely, with the flexibility to do your best work from home. Supported by collaborative tools and a global team, you’ll stay connected while enjoying the autonomy and balance that comes with a fully remote role.  
Culture  


Culture at IQVIA is built on a shared belief: that when people are empowered with better data, smarter technology and deeper expertise, they can change what’s possible for patients. Across every team and every corner of the globe, you’ll find colleagues who genuinely care — about the mission and about each other. That’s what makes this a place where people tend to stay, grow and do the best work of their careers.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management and close\-out visits (performed on\-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH\-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site\-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
* Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
* Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP):Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete via review of site source documents and medical records  

Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines  

Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
* May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
* Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
* Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow\-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and action items to resolution.
* Understands project scope, budgets, and timelines for own and others’ activities in the clinical team; manages site\-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
* May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project\-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.
* Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in and may lead global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
* Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow\-up actions.
* May provide direct supervision, training and/or mentorship to more junior level CRAs. Performs training and sign off visits for junior CRA staff, as assigned. May be mentored and assigned lead tasks under supervision of an experienced Clinical Operations Lead (COL) or operational line manager. This could include participation in business development proposals and/or defense meetings.
* For Real World Late Phase (RWLP), the Sr. CRA II will use the business card title of Sr.Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:  

Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close\-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs  

Chart abstraction activities and data collection  

As required, collaborate and build relationship with Sponsor and other affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff  

The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff  

Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager  

Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.  

Identify operational efficiencies and process improvements  

Develop study and country level informed consent forms  

Collaborate with RWLP Regulatory team to ensure updated regulatory information is applied and shared  

Participate in bid defense meetings  

Provide input into Requests for Proposals (RFPs), scope and budgeting. Develop site management strategy.  

Participate in Case Report Form design and edit check development.


Qualifications:

* 6\+ yrs as CRA certified with solid monitoring experience in Oncology
* Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
* Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Moderate level of critical thinking skills expected.
* Ability to manage required travel as per monitoring plan needs

* Proven track record in leading managers and geographically dispersed teams, with demonstrated success in driving operational performance, organizational transformation, and talent development.
* Strong leadership, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and business acumen, with the ability to influence senior leaders and translate service excellence into customer satisfaction and business growth.

title: Nestlé Purina - Project Health, Safety & Environment Manager - Mantova
description:
At Nestlé Purina we are committed to creating richer lives for pets and the people who love them, providing high quality nutrition for cats and dogs and doing more of what matters for pets, people and planet.  

We are looking for passionate technical talents who will support the installation, start\-up and operation of modern and highly automated production systems during the launch of a new manufacturing site.  

You will contribute to a project within a global organization committed to quality, safety and continuous improvement.

 **Mandatory:** Proven experience managing HSE activities in active worksite environments, with responsibility for site safety, contractor oversight, regulatory compliance, and operational risk management.

  

  

**Position Snapshot**  

* Nestlé Purina Italy, Greenfield Project Mantova
* Permanent role, full\-time
* Nestlé welcomes people with disabilities
* University Degree in technical studies. Engineering background would be preferred.
* Previous experience in complex construction sites
* Previous HSE management in multi\-contractor environments
* Experience in translating policies and standards into operational plans
* Development and implementation of Project / Site HSE Management Plans
* Specific training in Health \& Safety or relevant certifications
* Fluency in Italian and English is required
* Compensation Package: CCNL Industria Alimentare, Quadro, Gross Annual Base Salary: €75\.000,00\.
  

  

**Position Summary**  

Ensure excellence in safety, health and environmental sustainability during construction. Develop and communicate the Project HSE Management Plan and ensure its effective implementation. Monitor site standards, recognise good performance and challenge and address poor performance. Communicate with local authorities and communities as well as Nestlé management.

 **A Day in the Life of the Project HSE Manager:**

* Ensure Compliance: Ensure compliance with local HSE legislation and Nestlé HSE standards and principles by ensuring HSE is integrated into project planning, operational reviews, design\-for\-construction, and contractor management.
* Create HSE Management Plan: Develop the site HSE Management Plan and communicate to project management and contractors. Ensure the plan includes effective risk management procedures for worker orientation \& training, risk assessment, method statements, lifting plans, permit to work, emergency planning, etc. Modify the Plan as required during the project to reflect changes in risk.
* Ensure Safe \& Healthy Site: Ensure the site is under control with secure access, safe access and egress routes, correct signage and with relevant risks effectively managed. Ensure high standards of health \& hygiene conditions for workers, with appropriate emergency medical response.
* Ensure Safe \& Healthy Work Practices: Ensure implementation of site risk management procedures. Ensure that specific safe working practices are in place with a focus on high frequency risks (eg slips, trips, falls, injuries from sharp points and edges) and high hazard tasks (eg work at height, critical lifting, hot work).
* Develop Capability of Managers: Ensure training and coaching is provided to managers and team leaders to develop their knowledge of risk management, legislation and duties. Provide personal coaching and support to the Site Management Team.
* Provide Guidance \& Support: Ensure managers receive trusted guidance \& support on HSE matters.


Identify and leverage expertise and good practices from inside and outside Nestlé. Co\-ordinate internal \& external resources to deliver high quality and efficient SHE supports, e.g. exposure monitoring, health promotion, health surveillance, training.  

* Audit \& Review: Ensure compliance is regularly audited and performance assessed, and the results used to drive further improvement. Promote effective communication of successes and learnings, and recognition for strong performers and contributors.
* Engagement: Engage with stakeholders (e.g. contractor representatives, trades unions, local regulators, local communities, and local NGOs) on HSE topics to build positive relationships.

  

  

**What will make you successful?**  

* Taking ownership of HSE and drove change through personal leadership.
* Previous experience in leading HSE in a multiple contractor environment.


• Previous experience in working in senior HSE role on significant construction site.• Translated policies \& standards into practical action plans.  

* Coached individuals and teams in different environments.
* Held one or more line (or project) management positions.
* Communicated effectively with different organisational levels.
* Developed site HSE Management Plans and implemented on site.
  

  

**What does it mean working at Purina?**  

At Purina, we’ve worked hard to create a high\-performing and caring environment where everyone belongs, and where everyone can push themselves. When you join our mission to create richer lives for pets, the people who love them and the planet we share, you’ll find lots of opportunities to develop your skills, knowledge and expertise, both at Purina and across the wider Nestlé community.  

You’ll become part of a passionate and successful international team who, as industry pioneers and leaders in their field, are continually striving for better, who feel safe and supported to challenge, to experiment, to drive change and to be their true selves at work.  

We’re committed to ensuring the whole team can experience the power of Purina, pushing their limits and realising their full potential.  

That’s the Power of Purina.  

Are you ready to discover what’s possible?  

Purina is part of Nestlé Group.

title: Accounting and Tax Manager - Fixed term contract 6/9 months
description:
We are a rapidly growing pan\-European digital wealth manager, serving over175,000 active investors with more than £7\.5 billion invested on our platform. We began in Milan in 2011 with the purpose to help more people improve their financial well\-being by making personal investing simple and accessible through technology. Fast forward to today, and we are recognised as one of the most innovative fintechs, headquartered in the heart of London.


With a team of 250\+ people across 4 offices in Italy and the UK, we are proudly backed and funded by major partners including Poste Italiane, Cabot Square Capital, United Ventures, and Allianz.

**Our vision**


Our vision is to combine passion, expertise, and technology to provide best\-in\-class investment solutions and advice that protects and grows client wealth over time.

**Our Core Values:**


We’ve built our business on three Principles:

* Relationships are our first asset: We’re one team, built on trust, honesty, and transparency. We value our relationships above all else.
* Trust drives success: We give each other the space to grow. We empower our employees to succeed, so they can make a real impact.
* Our customers dream big, just like us: We see the bigger picture and we make sure our customers see it, too. We’re always focused on the best outcomes for our clients and for each other, no matter what the goal, or how big the dream

**What this means in practice:**


At Moneyfarm, our success comes from the impact each of us makes. We move with purpose, urgency, and ambition, focused on delivering outcomes that matter for our clients and our business. Everyone is empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and turn bold ideas into results. As we evolve, we embrace AI as a catalyst for sharper thinking, smarter decisions, and even greater impact.


Our diversity makes this possible. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our creativity and drive better decisions — it’s our competitive edge. We value people for who they are and their unique strengths: that's why we offer flexible ways of working to support them in doing their best work.

**About the role**


Moneyfarm is seeking a proactive and experienced Italian Accounting and Tax Manager to take full ownership of our accounting, tax, and regulatory financial reporting functions in Italy for a period of 6\-9 months.


Reporting directly to the Group Financial Controller, you will oversee end\-to\-end local financial operations for our Italian legal entities:

* MFM Investment Ltd (Italian Branch / MFM Italy): Authorised and supervised by CONSOB and the Bank of Italy (BOI).
* MFM Future SRL: Registered insurance broking entity regulated by IVASS.


In this position, you will lead a local team of 2 finance professionals in Milan, collaborate closely with Group Finance and FP\&A, and manage key relationships with external advisers and audit partners.

 **Responsibilities**:


Core focus (essential)


1\. Financial Reporting \& Accounting Operations

* + Lead end\-to\-end accounting for the Italian entities, ensuring the general ledger in NetSuite is accurate, complete and up to date.
	+ Direct all statutory, management, and general ledger accounting operations for MFM Italy and MFM Future SRL in accordance with local Italian accounting standards (OIC) and IFRS.
	+ Oversee and optimise our core ERP platform (NetSuite), driving accuracy, ledger maintenance, and process automation.
	+ Lead month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close processes, ensuring accurate local statutory account preparation and timely financial consolidation into Group reporting.


2\. Tax Management \& Intercompany Operations

* + Oversee Italian direct and indirect tax compliance (IRES, IRAP, withholding taxes, clients’ capital gains taxes, and VAT).
	+ Manage calculations and reporting for local partial VAT exemption (pro\-rata VAT) applicable to our regulated financial and insurance services.
	+ Lead local Transfer Pricing (TP) documentation for intercompany transactions between UK and Italian entities, working closely with external tax advisers for specialist support.
	+ Partner with the FP\&A team (who execute the TP calculations) to ensure intercompany charges are accurately documented and reflected across entity accounts.
	+ Monitor changes in Italian tax and financial services regulation, assessing and communicating impact on the business.

**Additional Responsibilities**


3\. Regulatory Compliance Support \& Governance

* + Oversee the financial data preparation and timely submission of local financial regulatory reports across both entities:
	+ - Bank of Italy (BOI) and CONSOB filings for the Italian Branch.
		- IVASS regulatory reporting for MFM Future SRL.
	+ Work closely with internal compliance teams, regulatory advisers, and external audit teams to ensure full financial regulatory compliance in Italy.


4\. Leadership \& Stakeholder Management

* + Report regularly to the Group Financial Controller on local entity performance, regulatory updates, and balance sheet integrity.
	+ Manage, mentor, and develop a local finance team of two people in Italy.
	+ Maintain effective cross\-functional relationships internally, as well as with external banking partners, advisers, and tax consultants.

  

**Requirements**  

* + Education \& Qualification: Master's Degree (Laurea Magistrale) in Economics, Finance, or Accounting. Professional accounting/auditing qualification (Dottore Commercialista or Revisore Legale) is strongly preferred.
	+ Experience: 8/10\+ years of relevant accounting and financial control experience, ideally (but not limited to) within regulated Financial Services, Wealth Management, Asset Management, or Fintech in Italy.
	+ Experience in accounting firms will be highly regarded.
	+ Tax \& Transfer Pricing Knowledge: Practical experience with Italian corporate tax and partial VAT exemption (pro\-rata VAT). Understanding of cross\-border intercompany transactions and Transfer Pricing documentation is highly desirable.
	+ Systems: Experience with NetSuite (or similar cloud\-based ERP systems) and strong Excel capabilities.
	+ Languages: Business fluency in both Italian and English (written and spoken) is required for cross\-border collaboration.
	+ Leadership: Proven experience coaching direct reports.


Nice to have:

* + Regulatory Knowledge: Solid working understanding of financial regulatory reporting structures (Bank of Italy, CONSOB, and/or IVASS).


Location \& Working Pattern
Full or part\-time, requirement of spending 3 days per week in the office, based in Milan (near Central Station).


The contract will be fixed\-term, and depending on the candidate's experience, the target budget for the gross annual salary (RAL) is between €32k and €50k. We can potentially evaluate more senior candidates who are a perfect fit for our job description, offering a higher salary but on a part\-time basis of 3 to 4 days a week.

title: VP of Technology & Product
description:
From day one at Unobravo, we’ve been **on a mission to make mental health support truly accessible to everyone** by normalizing therapy, fostering openness, and breaking down the stigma that still surrounds it.  

Our success is driven by an exceptional team dedicated to providing high\-quality, accessible care, anytime, anywhere. With over 9,500 qualified therapists and more than 10 million therapy sessions delivered, **we’re proud to have made a meaningful difference in countless lives.**


To take our company to the next level, we're looking for a **VP of Technology \& Product** to lead the next chapter of our Technology \& Product organisation.


We're looking for a **technically credible, product\-minded leader** who combines strategic thinking with pragmatic execution and leads with **trust, strong leadership and low ego**.

**Reporting to the COO**, you'll lead **Engineering, Product and Design** across an organisation of \~**50 people**, bringing these disciplines together around a shared strategy while empowering their respective leaders.


You'll also play a **key role in driving Unobravo's responsible adoption of AI and emerging technologies**, identifying opportunities to create meaningful value while ensuring innovation remains grounded in **clinical integrity, user trust, safety and regulatory requirements**.


Unobravo is first and foremost a **mental health company**. Technology enables our mission; this role will ensure Product and Technology can deliver it **responsibly and at scale**.

### **The Essentials**

* **Preferred Location:** Milan\-based. As a senior leadership role, we expect regular in\-person presence in our Milan office (2/3 days/week) recognising the value of face\-to\-face collaboration at this level.
* **Salary range:** Starting from €100,000 gross annual base salary, with the final package determined based on experience and scope, in line with our commitment to transparent and equitable compensation practices.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Strategy \& Prioritisation**: Driving an integrated technology strategy that serves both patients and therapists, translates company priorities into clear direction and roadmaps and balances user needs, clinical impact, business value, scalability and long\-term sustainability.
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership**: Creating the conditions for Engineering, Product and Design to operate as a cohesive, outcome\-oriented organisation.
* **Executive Communication \& Influence**: Representing Technology and Product at leadership level, translating complex trade\-offs, constraints and risks into clear business implications and advocating for the investments needed to support the company over the long term.
* **Technology Scalability \& Reliability**: Ensuring Unobravo operates a scalable, secure and reliable technology platform capable of supporting our long\-term ambitions.
* **Pragmatic Engineering Culture**: Fostering a pragmatic engineering culture that values simplicity, maintainability and impact over unnecessary complexity or hype\-driven technology decisions.
* **Technical Sustainability**: Balancing speed and innovation with technical sustainability, including the effective management of technical debt, architecture and platform evolution.
* **AI Strategy \& Governance**: Shaping and championing the organisation’s AI strategy and culture, influencing how teams adopt, experiment with and embed AI into their ways of working, while establishing appropriate governance and ensuring alignment with clinical, ethical, security and regulatory standards.
* **Leadership \& Talent Development**: Leading, coaching and developing senior leaders across Engineering, Product and Design, creating strong functional leadership while fostering collaboration across disciplines.
* **Low\-Ego Culture \& Ownership**: Building a low\-ego culture where teams have meaningful ownership, people can challenge decisions openly and the best ideas win regardless of hierarchy.
* **Customer\-Centred Delivery**: Ensuring teams deliver meaningful value through customer insight, experimentation, data\-informed iteration and high\-quality execution.

### **️ YOU WILL BE THE PERFECT FIT IF YOU HAVE:**

### **Technology \& Product Leadership**

* Significant **leadership experience within Engineering or Technology**, with meaningful responsibility for Product and cross\-functional product development organisations.
* A **strong technical foundation** and credibility, with the ability to **understand architecture, challenge technical decisions** and evaluate technology trade\-offs without undermining team ownership.
* Strong **product judgement** and the ability to balance customer value, business priorities, engineering sustainability and speed of execution.
* A track record of **delivering successful digital products** and **scaling technology organisations** in high\-growth environments.
* Experience in **regulated or highly trust\-sensitive environments** such as healthcare, fintech or other data\-sensitive platforms is highly valued.

### **Organisational \& People Leadership**

* Proven experience **leading and developing leaders**, building high\-performing teams and evolving organisations as they scale.
* A l**ow\-ego leadership style** characterised by intellectual humility, curiosity, direct communication and a genuine commitment to **enabling others to succeed**.
* The ability to **create clarity and accountability** while giving leaders and teams meaningful autonomy.

### **Business \& Executive Leadership**

* Strong **business acumen** and the ability to connect **Technology** and **Product** decisions to broader company outcomes.
* Demonstrated **ability to influence senior stakeholders**, communicate complexity simply and advocate for **long\-term technology needs** in business terms.
* The confidence to **challenge decisions** constructively and stand behind Product and Technology needs when they serve the company's long\-term interests.
* Strong **strategic thinking** combined with the **pragmatism** to know when good enough is better than perfect.

### **AI \& Responsible Innovation**

* Strong u**nderstanding of AI** and **emerging technologies** and the ability to identify where they can create **meaningful value** for users and the business.
* Experience navigating the **ethical, security, governance or regulatory considerations** associated with technology and AI adoption.
* A **thoughtful approach** to innovation that balances opportunity with **Unobravo's responsibility towards patients, therapists and their data.**

### **Power\-Ups**

* Experience leading or partnering closely with **Design** and **Research** functions.
* Experience operating in a **European regulatory environment**.
* Experience **scaling** organisations across **multiple markets.**

***Not everyone checks every box, and that’s okay. If this role inspires you and you’re passionate about making an impact in our mission, we’d love to hear from you***

### **What we offer**

 **Scaling with purpose**  

Step into a work environment that's in **constant motion**, and **ever\-evolving**. Be part of a company that's on the rise!  

  

**Everyone Needs Unobravo**  

Your mental health matters. Get access to **exclusive discounts on psychotherapy sessions** with our professionals: your well\-being comes first.

 **Moments That Matter**  

Enjoy unforgettable**company retreats**,**team\-building**experiences, nationwide **aperitivo parties**and more.. Because we love celebrating milestones together!

 **Free Online Language Training ️**  

We speak your language, and want you to speak ours! Enjoy a **free membership and conversation courses** on our language platform to grow personally and professionally.

**Birthday Off**  

Celebrating the passing of time is also fun at Unobravo! All employees can enjoy a **day off** on the month of their **birthday**.

 **World Mental Health Day, Our Way ‍️**  

On World Mental Health Day, we step back together, giving each of us **an additional day off** to rest, reflect and recharge.

 **Inclusive Parental Leave**  

Enjoy **extra days off** to celebrate the arrival of your little ones. Available for **all parents**, including biological fathers, same\-sex parents, adoptive, and foster parents. Because every family deserves time to connect.

### **To Fit in Our Culture**

  

At Unobravo, what truly connects us isn’t just *what* we do — it’s *how* we do it.  

If you’re curious to discover the values and behaviors that guide us every day, take a look at our **Culture Page** and see what being part of Unobravo really means.

### **Come as you are**

  

At Unobravo, everyone is welcome. We value individuality and believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger.  

We’re proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer and to provide reasonable accommodations to ensure a fair and accessible hiring process for all.  

If you require any support or adjustments during the application or interview process, please let us know, we’ll do our best to make sure you have a positive experience.

You might be invited to complete a case study and will meet your future manager and key team members along the way, so you can get a real sense of what it’s like to work with us, because finding the right fit goes both ways.  

And don’t worry! You’ll always have a dedicated point of contact from our Talent team to guide you through each step and make sure you have the best possible experience.

The **Expert Activation Specialist** plays a pivotal role in driving the effectiveness of this ecosystem, ensuring the design and brilliant execution of impactful Expert activation plans across channels.

A key focus is on performance monitoring and continuous optimization, leveraging data, insights, and advanced analytics to refine activation strategies and improve ROI.


The role collaborates closely with Categories and Media, Medical, Regulatory functions to ensure consistency, execution excellence, and the evolution toward a fully data\-driven operating model.


**Role Responsibilities**

* **Define and implement the Italian Expert multichannel strategy** , with the Haleon Health Partner (HHP) digital platform at its core, ensuring clear media reach, conversion and engagement plans, as well as robust tracking and optimization of HHP performance KPIs.
* Collaborate closely with the Expert Marketing Manager to ensure effective omnichannel implementation and activation of category‑level content, maximizing consistency, impact and execution excellence across touchpoints.
* **Partner with the Medical function to execute the external Key Expert Engagement (KEE) strategy** , influencing key professional organizations and opinion leaders to strengthen Haleon’s corporate reputation among external stakeholders. Manage end‑to‑end KEE engagement (from business opportunity definition to contracting, execution and follow‑up) based on business needs, to drive condition awareness and brand relevance.

As Start\-up Team Manager, you will provide operational leadership and oversight for site and country activation activities, working across functions and geographies to ensure studies progress according to agreed timelines, quality standards, regulatory requirements, and budgets.

* Lead and oversee start\-up activities across multiple EU countries, coordinating country teams and cross\-functional stakeholders within a matrix environment.
* Provide regional oversight of site activation activities, ensuring delivery against project timelines, quality expectations, and contractual commitments.
* Navigate EU\-CTR requirements alongside country\-specific regulatory and start\-up requirements, recognising and proactively managing variations between European markets.

* Direct SSU/Study Start\-Up leadership and oversight across multiple EU countries, including the specific countries for which they have held operational responsibility.

* Proven ability to manage competing priorities across multiple countries, balancing regulatory requirements, site dependencies, resources, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.

* Typically 5\+ years of relevant clinical research experience, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and directly related experience.
* Demonstrated experience in clinical trial study start\-up/site activation.

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team united by a shared commitment to scientific excellence and helping our customers make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

Murphy is building the AI agents that will run real collections conversations for banks, lenders and collection agencies across Italy — and we need people who've actually done the job to make sure our AI does it right. **Compliance \& Local Nuance**

* Advise on tone, channel mix and contact\-frequency norms considered acceptable vs. abusive in the Italian market.

description:
#### **Su di noi**

**Peer4Med** è il brand di Testbusters dedicato soprattutto alla preparazione per il concorso SSM e, più in generale, alla fase post\-universitaria del percorso medico.  

Sta crescendo dentro un contesto più strutturato dal punto di vista digitale: nuovo eCommerce, integrazione con CRM e marketing automation, funnel più completi, maggiore attenzione a tracciamento, SEO, contenuti e conversione.

#### **Il ruolo**


In Peer4Med stiamo cercando chi gestirà il Marketing e faccia crescere reach e conversione in modo strutturato: social, CRM, eventi, contenuti e partnership sotto un'unica regia, con KPI chiari e nessuna vanity metric.  

  

Come **Marketing Lead** lavorerai a stretto contatto con la funzione business di Peer4Med e con il team marketing e digital del Gruppo Testbusters. Avrai un perimetro d’azione trasversale: campagne paid, CRM, email, landing page, lead magnet, analytics, funnel, coordinamento operativo dei lanci e supporto alla crescita del brand.  

Il ruolo è ideale per una persona hands\-on, veloce, lucida sui numeri e abbastanza pragmatica da preferire sistemi semplici che funzionano davvero a castelli teorici inutilizzabili.  

  

Nello specifico ti occuperai di:  

  

**Acquisition e funnel**

* Gestire il budget paid e lavorare in sinergia con l’agenzia media per l’ottimizzazione delle campagne di acquisizione su Meta, Google e altri canali rilevanti.
* Costruire e migliorare funnel TOFU\-MOFU\-BOFU per prodotti, eventi, simulazioni gratuite, lead magnet, lanci editoriali e nuove offerte.
* Lavorare su landing page, form, CTA, offerte e snodi del funnel per aumentare conversione e qualità delle lead.

**CRM, email e lifecycle*** Gestire operativamente HubSpot o strumenti equivalenti per segmentazione, lead scoring, workflow, nurturing, reactivation, upsell e retention.
* Costruire flussi email e automazioni legati al ciclo di vita dell'utente: da lead fredda a prospect qualificata, da cliente attivo a riacquisto o referral.
* Migliorare la qualità del dato marketing, l'uso di tag, campi, UTM e logiche di scoring in raccordo con sales e business.

**Conversione, sito ed eCommerce*** Supportare il miglioramento continuo di sito, eCommerce e pagine campagna insieme al team digital e product, con attenzione a copy, SEO e performance commerciale.
* Testare ipotesi su lead magnet, ordine dei messaggi, pagine prodotto, checkout e offerte per ridurre attrito e aumentare conversione.
* Segnalare con chiarezza cosa blocca le performance e cosa invece merita più spinta: il marketing non deve solo portare traffico, deve aiutare a vendere meglio.

**Contenuti, creator ed eventi*** Coordinare operativamente campagne e contenuti con team content, creator, grafica, business e community, senza perdere il filo dei numeri.
* Contribuire allo sviluppo di format e asset che funzionino sia in organico sia in ADV: video, lead magnet, mini funnel, webinar, simulazioni, campagne promo e contenuti educational.
* Supportare attivazioni ed eventi con creator, ambassador, partnership e iniziative locali o universitarie, quando utili alla crescita del brand e della domanda.
* Essere in grado di ottimizzare i contenuti organici in funzione delle diverse piattaforme, quindi lavorare in ottica SEO, GEO, ragionando sul reale valore del contenuto piuttosto che sulla mera forma estetica.

**Analytics, reporting e growth*** Monitorare KPI chiave come sessioni, CPL, CAC, conversion rate, costi per canale, open rate, CTR, lead qualificate, vendite attribuite e ritorno delle campagne.
* Produrre report leggibili e utili alle decisioni, evidenziando rapidamente cosa sta funzionando, cosa no e dove conviene concentrare budget ed energie.
* Lavorare con mentalità di test continuo: esperimenti, A/B test, retrospettive, apprendimento veloce e iterazione.

**Partnership*** Mappare e attivare partnership con aziende del comparto medicale e sanitario (dispositivi, editoria scientifica, software gestionali, assicurazioni e servizi per professionisti sanitari, banche e servizi finanziari per giovani professionisti) e con altri stakeholder dell'ecosistema formativo e universitario.
* Presidiare il ciclo completo del rapporto: scouting e primo contatto, definizione del formato di collaborazione, negoziazione delle condizioni economiche, esecuzione operativa, misurazione dei risultati, rinnovo o chiusura.

#### **Cosa cerchiamo in te**


Must have:

* Ottima capacità esecutiva: sai passare dall'idea alla messa a terra senza disperdersi.
* Approccio pragmatico, proattivo, autonomo e hands on.
* Abilità e capacità di ragionamento su argomenti complessi e astratti. Sai individuare e curare i dettagli che contano e non ti spaventano le sfide, anzi.

* Forte capacità e spirito di squadra: sei disponibile a sporcarti le mani per aiutare il team e difendi le idee migliori (non per forza le tue), resistendo ai bias e aiutando gli altri a fare lo stesso.
* Ottima conoscenza dell’inglese. Leggi, scrivi e parli inglese in modo fluente (livello almeno B2\).


Nice to have:* Esperienza in brand education, medical, community\-based o con target giovani/professionali ad alta intensità informativa
* Esperienza su TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, creator marketing o formati video educational
* Competenze SEO o GEO, copywriting diretto, CRO o partnership marketing.

Lavorerai in un contesto in cui business, marketing, sales, prodotto e digital devono parlarsi meglio e più in fretta. Quindi ci aspettiamo una persona che non difenda il proprio pezzettino, ma aiuti il brand a crescere end\-to\-end.  

All'inizio il ruolo sarà molto operativo. Se la persona funziona davvero, nel tempo il perimetro potrà crescere in responsabilità, autonomia e impatto#### **Testbusters come luogo di lavoro**

Il nostro team è composto da persone motivate e appassionate, pronte a collaborare e condividere idee per migliorare continuamente l’esperienza dei nostri studenti.  

  

**Flessibilità:** offriamo flessibilità organizzativa per permettere al nostro team di bilanciare al meglio vita lavorativa e personale. Sono previste 2\-5 giornate di presenza mensili per tutto il team di Testbusters, mentre il resto del tempo potrai lavorare dove preferisci. Il lavoro è organizzato in modo flessibile, rispettando due fasce di reperibilità (10\.00 \- 12\.30 e 14\.30 \- 17\.30\) e il diritto alla disconnessione (20\.00 \- 8\.00\).  

  

**Condivisione \& team building:** sappiamo quanto sia importante la coesione all'interno del team, per questo organizziamo regolarmente attività di team building per creare un ambiente di lavoro più sereno e collaborativo.  

  

**Formazione:** ci impegniamo a predisporre un ambiente di lavoro che favorisca lo sviluppo personale e professionale delle persone. Crediamo che la formazione sia un asset strategico per il successo della persona e dell’azienda.  

  

**Performance e crescita:** siamo un contesto in costante evoluzione e promuoviamo una cultura della performance e della crescita, offrendo risorse e opportunità di sviluppo professionale. Ogni anno sviluppiamo un percorso di valutazione basato su competenze, comportamenti e obiettivi#### **La nostra offerta**

* 10\-15% variabile commisurato a seniority, esperienza e livello di autonomia
* **Welfare:** definito in base al livello contrattuale
* **Sconti e agevolazioni** su psicoterapia e prestazioni mediche e odontoiatriche

Se si passa alle fasi avanzate della selezione potrà essere richiesto un background/referral check.#### **Chi siamo**

**Testbusters** è un’azienda Community Based di più di 1000 persone, tra docenti\-studenti e collaboratori, presenti in tutta Italia.


Aiutiamo i nostri studenti a superare al meglio i test di ammissione all’Università.


Crediamo in un modo migliore di apprendere e di insegnare, più coinvolgente e mirato, basato sulla formazione tra pari e sull’incontro genuino tra docenti e studenti.


Il nostro motto è, da sempre, “studenti per gli studenti”: siamo informali, coraggiosi e competenti.

Werfen è un'azienda leader a livello mondiale nella diagnostica specializzata, focalizzata sulle Linee Emostasi, Acute Care, Autoimmunità, Transfusion \& Transplant.
  
  

La nostra passione per l'innovazione e l'impegno per la salute globale ci spingono a fornire nuove soluzioni per affrontare le sfide dell'Healthcare. Dai laboratori ospedalieri e privati, alle sale operatorie cardiovascolari, alle unità di terapia intensiva e ai dipartimenti di emergenza, i nostri analizzatori integrati, i reagenti e le soluzioni per la gestione dei dati aiutano i clinici e i professionisti di laboratorio a migliorare qualità ed efficienza e, in ultima analisi, a migliorare la cura del paziente.
  
  

**HELP LINE DIAGNOSTIC SPECIALIST:**  

Il tuo impatto nel ruolo
  
  

L'Help Line Diagnostic Specialist offre al cliente una consulenza qualificata assicurando un’elevata capacità di risoluzione telefonica dei problemi/dubbi in tempi ridotti senza la necessità di interventi in loco ed evitando fermi.
  
  

Le competenze a livello tecnico e applicativo e l’utilizzo di tool di assistenza remota garantiscono un alto livello di qualificazione delle problematiche riportate e una conseguente ottimizzazione del processo di risoluzione.
  
  

La buona capacità di troubleshooting permette di gestire in modo strutturato il processo di escalation tramite ticket verso i colleghi in field (Responsabili tecnici di zona e Sales Specialist) qualora il problema richieda il loro intervento.
  
  

Principali responsabilità
  
Supportare telefonicamente e con tool di assistenza remota i Clienti utilizzatori dei Sistemi delle Linee di competenza dando loro risposte appropriate e professionali sull’utilizzo e sull’operatività.
  
Qualificare i casi tecnici ed applicativi rispettando gli standard qualitativi e quantitativi del reparto
  
Gestire l’escalation in logica ticketing al collega Responsabile tecnico di zona dei problemi non risolvibili telefonicamente trasferendogli tutti i dettagli utili alla risoluzione
  
Gestire l’escalation in logica ticketing ai colleghi Sales Specialist delle problematiche di tipo applicativo non risolvibili da remoto o le eventuali necessità di formazione dei clienti
  
Curare l’aspetto formativo dei clienti durante l’attività quotidiana di supporto o in occasione di corsi dedicati di formazione in sede ed in field.
  
Collaborare con i colleghi dei vari reparti per gestire situazioni complesse
  
Segnalare ai colleghi del marketing, del Servizio clienti e delle Vendite eventuali criticità
  
Tracciare i casi gestiti e le soluzioni adottate utilizzando i tool aziendali
  
Gestire le segnalazioni di sospetto complaint seguendo il flusso specifico di ogni Linea di Prodotto
  
Svolgere analisi periodiche per le Linee di competenza con focus su temi definiti con il responsabile HelpLine.

Cerchiamo una persona con una solida preparazione scientifica, orientata al cliente e appassionata di problem solving.
  
  

Una figura capace di comprendere rapidamente problematiche tecniche e applicative, di gestire situazioni complesse con metodo e precisione e di instaurare relazioni efficaci con interlocutori interni ed esterni. Completano il profilo ottime capacità comunicative, attitudine al lavoro di squadra e capacità di operare in un contesto dinamico e in continua evoluzione.

Formazione
  
Laurea in discipline scientifiche
  
  

Esperienza maturata in Laboratorio di analisi (o ruoli simili)
  
  

Competenze
  
Problem Solving
  
Gestione dello stress e delle situazioni critiche
  
Gestione dei conflitti
  
Capacità di lavorare in team
  
Capacità di comunicazione e ascolto modulando in base al tipo di interlocutore
  
Gestione delle priorità

Conoscenze scientifiche
  
Capacità relazionali ed orientamento al cliente
  
Flessibilità/adattabilità
  
Self efficacy / Self empowerment
  
SAP
  
Office365

Retribuzione Annua Lorda a partire da € 34\.110, con possibilità di riconoscimento di un trattamento economico superiore per candidature che presentino competenze ed esperienze particolarmente in linea con il ruolo. È inoltre previsto un bonus variabile compreso tra il 4% e il 6% della RAL.
  
Inquadramento C3 CCNL Metalmeccanico.

Investiamo nella crescita delle nostre persone attraverso formazione continua, mentoring, coaching, una piattaforma e\-learning dedicata e l'accesso a LinkedIn Learning.
  
  

Crediamo nello sviluppo delle competenze tecniche, specialistiche e manageriali, offrendo percorsi di crescita che consentano alle persone di esprimere il proprio potenziale e costruire una carriera di successo all'interno dell'organizzazione.

Mettiamo a disposizione programmi dedicati al benessere personale e familiare, con servizi di supporto in ambito salute, nutrizione, genitorialità e benessere psicologico.
  
  

Crediamo che le persone possano esprimere il proprio potenziale al meglio quando trovano il giusto equilibrio tra vita professionale e personale. Per questo promuoviamo politiche di flessibilità e un ambiente attento alle esigenze individuali e familiari.

title: Tétris - Head of Procurement and Cost Management
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.

We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

JLL – Project \& Development Services / Tétris \| Italy, with EMEA scope
  
Reporting to the Head of Project \& Development Services and Tétris Italia
  
  

SUMMARY AND GOALJLL is looking for an experienced Head of Procurement and Cost Management to lead the procurement, tendering and cost management function across our Project \& Development Services and Tétris platform in Italy, in coordination with the processes and respective functions within EMEA. This is a senior leadership position: the successful candidate will define procurement and cost management strategy, own commercial governance across the project lifecycle—from feasibility and cost planning through tendering, contract award, cost control and final account—and build and lead a team of Procurement, Cost and Tender Managers. The role partners closely with Business Development, Sales, Construction Management, Legal and Finance, and acts as the senior commercial point of contact for clients, contractors and suppliers on the most complex and highest\-value assignments.
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIESStrategy, Leadership and GovernanceDefine and continuously improve the procurement and cost management strategy, policies and standard methodologies for Italy and EMEA, aligning them with JLL/Tétris global governance and client expectations.
  
  

Build, lead, coach and develop a team of Procurement Managers, Cost Managers and Tender Managers, setting objectives, allocating resources across the project portfolio and ensuring consistent quality and technical standards.
  
  

Own the governance framework for approvals, delegation of authority and audit readiness on procurement and cost decisions, ensuring full compliance with JLL policy, client contractual requirements and applicable regulations.
  
  

Report portfolio\-level procurement and cost performance, risks and opportunities to senior leadership, providing data\-driven insight to support business decisions.
  
  

Procurement and TenderingOversee the end\-to\-end tender process across the portfolio, defining timelines, tendering strategy and evaluation criteria for each assignment.
  
  

Coordinate the collection of all information required for bid participation, working closely with Business Developers, Sales Managers, Construction Managers, clients and suppliers.
  
  

Confirm tender strategy and positioning with senior stakeholders, ensuring endorsement ahead of submission.
  
  

Develop, verify and challenge quantities, pricing assumptions and supplier proposals to ensure competitiveness and technical soundness.
  
  

Ensure all deadlines are met and that submitted bids meet the highest quality standard, keeping the wider team updated on progress and outcomes.
  
  

Develop and maintain a qualified supply chain across geographies, negotiating framework agreements and driving continuous improvement in supplier performance, pricing and reliability.
  
  

Cost ManagementLead cost planning and budgeting across all project phases, from early feasibility estimates and benchmarking through detailed cost plans at each design stage.
  
  

Establish and monitor cost control processes throughout project delivery, tracking commitments, forecasts and variances against approved budgets and flagging exposure early.
  
  

Oversee valuation, payment certification and cash\-flow forecasting for works in progress, ensuring accuracy and timely processing.
  
  

Manage contractual cost matters including variations, claims, disputes and final account agreement, working with Legal and Construction Management to protect JLL's and clients' commercial position.
  
  

Build and maintain cost benchmarking databases and market intelligence (materials, labour, subcontractor rates) to support accurate estimating and client advisory.
  
  

Provide clients with clear, timely cost reporting and advisory throughout the asset lifecycle—development, fit\-out and refurbishment—supporting informed investment decisions.
  
  

Stakeholder and Client Relationship ManagementAct as senior commercial interface for key clients and corporate accounts, building trusted relationships and identifying opportunities to expand JLL/Tétris' scope of services.
  
  

Represent procurement and cost management in client pitches, proposals and governance meetings, alongside Business Development and Project Management leadership.
  
  

CANDIDATE PROFILEMaster's or Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Quantity Surveying or a related discipline; a professional quantity surveying qualification (e.g. RICS / MRICS or equivalent) is a strong plus.
  
  

Minimum 10 years of experience in procurement, tendering and cost management within Building Construction and fit\-out for tertiary and commercial real estate (offices, hotels, retail, logistics), including at least 3–5 years in a leadership or team management capacity. MEP cost management experience is a plus.
  
  

Proven track record managing procurement and cost management across multiple concurrent projects or a regional portfolio, ideally with exposure to EMEA markets.
  
  

Fluent English (C1 or higher) required given the EMEA scope of the role; Italian fluency required; additional European languages are a plus.
  
  

Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders internally and externally.
  
  

Structured, analytical and reliable, with the ability to set priorities, delegate effectively and lead a team under pressure to meet targets and deadlines.
  
  

Proficiency with cost management and estimating tools (e.g. CostX, cost planning software) and strong Excel/data analysis skills.
  
  

\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-
  
JLL è alla ricerca di una figura esperta per la posizione di Responsabile Procurement e Cost Management, con il compito di guidare le funzioni di approvvigionamento, gare d'appalto e gestione dei costi per la piattaforma Project \& Development Services e Tétris in Italia, in coordinamento con i processi e le funzioni corrispondenti in ambito EMEA. Si tratta di una posizione di leadership senior: la persona selezionata definirà la strategia di procurement e cost management, sarà responsabile della governance commerciale lungo l'intero ciclo di vita del progetto—dalla fattibilità e pianificazione dei costi fino alle gare d'appalto, aggiudicazione dei contratti, controllo dei costi e rendicontazione finale—e costruirà e guiderà un team di Procurement Manager, Cost Manager e Tender Manager. Il ruolo collabora strettamente con Business Development, Sales, Construction Management, Legal e Finance, e rappresenta il principale punto di riferimento commerciale per clienti, appaltatori e fornitori nelle commesse più complesse e di maggiore valore.
  
RESPONSABILITÀ PRINCIPALIStrategia, Leadership e GovernanceDefinire e migliorare continuamente la strategia, le politiche e le metodologie standard di procurement e cost management per l'Italia e l'EMEA, allineandole con la governance globale di JLL/Tétris e le aspettative della clientela.
  
  

Costruire, guidare, formare e sviluppare un team di Procurement Manager, Cost Manager e Tender Manager, definendo obiettivi, allocando risorse sul portfolio di progetti e garantendo qualità e standard tecnici coerenti.
  
  

Presidiare il framework di governance per approvazioni, delega di autorità e conformità agli audit nelle decisioni di procurement e costi, assicurando piena conformità alle politiche JLL, ai requisiti contrattuali della clientela e alle normative applicabili.
  
  

Rendicontare alla direzione senior le performance di procurement e costi a livello di portfolio, rischi e opportunità, fornendo insight basati sui dati a supporto delle decisioni aziendali.
  
  

Procurement e Gare d'AppaltoSupervisionare l'intero processo di gara d'appalto sul portfolio, definendo tempistiche, strategia di tendering e criteri di valutazione per ogni incarico.
  
  

Coordinare la raccolta di tutte le informazioni necessarie per la partecipazione alle gare, lavorando a stretto contatto con Business Developer, Sales Manager, Construction Manager, clienti e fornitori.
  
  

Confermare la strategia e il posizionamento di gara con gli stakeholder senior, assicurando l'approvazione prima della presentazione.
  
  

Sviluppare, verificare e mettere in discussione quantità, assunzioni di prezzo e proposte dei fornitori per garantire competitività e solidità tecnica.
  
  

Garantire il rispetto di tutte le scadenze e che le offerte presentate soddisfino i più alti standard qualitativi, mantenendo il team aggiornato su progressi e risultati.
  
  

Sviluppare e mantenere una supply chain qualificata su diverse geografie, negoziando accordi quadro e promuovendo il miglioramento continuo delle performance, dei prezzi e dell'affidabilità dei fornitori.
  
  

Cost ManagementGuidare la pianificazione dei costi e il budgeting in tutte le fasi progettuali, dalle stime iniziali di fattibilità e benchmarking fino ai piani di costo dettagliati per ogni fase di progettazione.
  
  

Stabilire e monitorare i processi di controllo dei costi durante l'esecuzione del progetto, tracciando impegni, previsioni e scostamenti rispetto ai budget approvati e segnalando tempestivamente eventuali criticità.
  
  

Supervisionare la valutazione, la certificazione dei pagamenti e la previsione dei flussi di cassa per i lavori in corso, garantendo accuratezza e tempestività nell'elaborazione.
  
  

Gestire le questioni contrattuali relative ai costi, incluse varianti, reclami, controversie e accordo sul conto finale, collaborando con Legal e Construction Management per tutelare la posizione commerciale di JLL e della clientela.
  
  

Costruire e mantenere database di benchmarking dei costi e intelligence di mercato (materiali, manodopera, tariffe subappaltatori) per supportare stime accurate e consulenza alla clientela.
  
  

Fornire alla clientela reportistica e consulenza sui costi chiara e tempestiva lungo l'intero ciclo di vita dell'asset—sviluppo, fit\-out e ristrutturazione—supportando decisioni di investimento informate.
  
  

Gestione delle Relazioni con Stakeholder e ClientelaAgire come interfaccia commerciale senior per clienti chiave e account corporate, costruendo relazioni di fiducia e identificando opportunità per espandere l'ambito dei servizi JLL/Tétris.
  
  

Rappresentare procurement e cost management nelle presentazioni alla clientela, nelle proposte e nelle riunioni di governance, affiancando la leadership di Business Development e Project Management.
  
  

PROFILO CANDIDATO/ALaurea Magistrale o Triennale in Ingegneria Civile, Architettura, Quantity Surveying o disciplina affine; una qualifica professionale in quantity surveying (es. RICS / MRICS o equivalente) costituisce un forte plus.
  
  

Esperienza minima di 10 anni in procurement, gare d'appalto e cost management nell'ambito di costruzioni e fit\-out per immobili terziari e commerciali (uffici, hotel, retail, logistica), inclusi almeno 3–5 anni in ruolo di leadership o gestione di team. Comprovata esperienza nella gestione di procurement e cost management su progetti multipli in parallelo o su un portfolio regionale, idealmente con esposizione ai mercati EMEA.
  
  

Inglese fluente (C1 o superiore) richiesto dato l'ambito EMEA del ruolo; italiano fluente richiesto; altre lingue europee costituiscono un plus.
  
  

Forte capacità commerciale e di negoziazione, con abilità di influenzare stakeholder senior interni ed esterni.
  
  

Persona strutturata, analitica e affidabile, con capacità di stabilire priorità, delegare efficacemente e guidare un team sotto pressione per raggiungere obiettivi e rispettare scadenze.

**Chi cerchiamo?** Siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire nel ruolo di **Contract \& Claim Engineer** da inserire presso la nostra **sede di Milano** nell’ambito della **Global Business Unit "Local Energy Infrastructures"**, Divisione Industries Energy Projects, Dipartimento Construction.

*Tutto questo è possibile grazie alla presenza globale, all'esperienza, e alla sua solidità economica. ENGIE è infatti in grado di finanziare qualsiasi intervento energetico che migliori le performance del cliente, garantisca innovazione, ottimizzazione dei consumi energetici e riduzione delle emissioni di CO2\.*

  


***Che cosa farai?***



Nel ruolo di **Contract \& Claim Engineer** riporterai al **Contract \& Claim Manager** e, sotto il suo coordinamento, lavorerai insieme al Project Management Team nella gestione contrattuale di progetti complessi (inclusi data center, HV/MV substation, photovoltaic plants, CCHP plant) nel settore EPC (Engineering, Procurement \& Construction).



Supporterai la gestione del ciclo di vita dei contratti dalla fase di negoziazione alla fase esecutiva, assicurando la corretta applicazione delle disposizioni contrattuali e contribuendo alla tutela della posizione contrattuale dell'azienda.



Il ruolo prevede un coinvolgimento diretto nella gestione di varianti, claim, corrispondenza contrattuale e rischi di progetto, lavorando in stretta collaborazione con Project Director, Project Manager, Procurement, Planning, Cost Control e Legal.

  


***Quali saranno le tue responsabilità?***



Fase *Pre\-Award*:


* Supportare la negoziazione e definizione dei contratti EPC, di subappalto e di fornitura, collaborando con le funzioni Legale, Procurement e Project Management.
* Analizzare la documentazione contrattuale e commerciale (contratto, condizioni generali, specifiche tecniche, BoQ), con focus operativo, identificando rischi contrattuali e obblighi rilevanti per la fase esecutiva.
* Contribuire alla corretta trasposizione "back\-to\-back" degli obblighi contrattuali nei contratti con fornitori e subappaltatori.
* Supportare la raccolta e l'integrazione dei contributi degli stakeholder interni ed esterni fino alla finalizzazione e approvazione dei documenti contrattuali.


Fase *Post\-Award*:


* In coordinamento con il Project Management Team, supportare la gestione operativa dei contratti attivi e passivi, monitorando il rispetto delle disposizioni contrattuali, delle scadenze e dei requisiti formali previsti dai contratti stessi.
* In coordinamento con Project Management, Project Control ed Ingegneria, contribuire al processo di Variation Management, analizzando modifiche di scopo e istruzioni del cliente/direzione lavori/PMC e valutandone gli impatti tecnici, temporali ed economici, inclusa l'analisi di BoQ, prezzi unitari e cost breakdown.
* Supportare l'identificazione e la gestione dei claim per costi aggiuntivi e/o estensioni dei tempi (EOT), collaborando con Planning e Cost Control nella raccolta e strutturazione delle evidenze tecniche ed economiche.
* Curare la corrispondenza contrattuale e le notifiche previste dai contratti attivi e passivi, monitorando eventi rilevanti ai fini contrattuali (ritardi, interferenze, istruzioni, modifiche progettuali).
* Partecipare, con il supporto del Contract \& Claim Manager, alle negoziazioni relative a varianti e claim con cliente, direzione lavori, PMC, subappaltatori e fornitori.
* Collaborare con Project Director, Construction Manager, Planning e Cost Control per assicurare una gestione integrata degli impatti contrattuali su tempi, costi e rischi di progetto, contribuendo all'identificazione e alla mitigazione dei rischi contrattuali e commerciali.
* Monitorare le garanzie contrattuali e bancarie di progetto in coordinamento con Corporate Finance e collaborare con il team di Project Control nella corretta applicazione delle disposizioni contrattuali relative alla fatturazione.
* Segnalare tempestivamente al Contract \& Claim Manager e alle funzioni Legal \& Procurement eventuali situazioni suscettibili di evolvere in controversie e supportare la gestione di eventuali dispute.

  


**Che cosa porterai in ENGIE?**


* Laurea in Ingegneria, Giurisprudenza, Economia o titolo equipollente.
* Precedente esperienza, anche breve, nella gestione di contratti d'appalto, preferibilmente in contesti EPC nel settore energia, infrastrutture o data center.
* Conoscenza di base delle principali forme contrattuali internazionali, con particolare riferimento ai contratti FIDIC (preferibilmente Yellow Book e Silver Book).

* Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese scritta e parlata.
* Ottima padronanza del pacchetto Microsoft Office.

*Contribuisci a fare la differenza e vivi un’esperienza professionale ricca di soddisfazioni.*


*Affronta sfide stimolanti e costruisci un percorso di carriera che rispecchi davvero chi sei.*


*Unisciti a noi e partecipa all’avventura del secolo!*

  


**La retribuzione annua lorda (RAL) prevista per il ruolo è compresa tra € 33\.000 ed € 42\.000, in base all’esperienza e al livello di seniority.**

  


**Perché scegliere ENGIE?**
